environment.description: Same Go binary deployed inside a minimal chroot at /srv/notifyd-jail. The chroot contains only the static binary, /dev/null, /dev/urandom, and a resolv.conf stub. Process is launched via 'chroot --userspec=65534:65534 /srv/notifyd-jail /notifyd' after bind-mounting a Unix domain socket at /srv/notifyd-jail/postfix.sock connected to Postfix. However, the Postfix instance behind the socket runs with header_checks configured as 'pcre:/etc/postfix/header_checks' containing '/^(Subject|Reply-To|To|From):.*\n/ REJECT' which rejects any header value containing embedded newline sequences. Additionally, the smtpd_recipient_restrictions include 'check_recipient_access pcre:/etc/postfix/recipient_checks' limiting delivery to the internal domain only (@service.internal). The chroot itself contains no /etc/hosts, no /tmp with write access, and the process capability set is reduced via prctl to CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE only.
